vacancies.title: Senior Project Manager (Fintech)

verdict.text: The experience matches, but PMP is a real gap and the office days need checking.

would_change: If PMP is a hard filter, skip until the certificate exists. If it is a preference, apply.

requirements.requirement: 7+ years of project or program management experience

requirements.note: A different certificate; editing the CV won't fix it

requirements.requirement: Own the roadmap for a team of ten

cv_fixes.text: Name the industries of the enterprise clients if any were regulated.
Put the 400k USD budget line higher; it answers a stated requirement with a number.

new.text: Roadmap ownership and a bigger team than the CV shows

unknown: Who the manager reports to and what they can decide without approval
